jobs.title: Product Manager, Performance AI
jobs.description: WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.  We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.    We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.   Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.    For more information, visit WPP.com.     WHO WE ARE About Data & Technology Solutions WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation. WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost. We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.   WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Product Owner with a passion for leveraging data to build impactful products. In this role, you will support the product development lifecycle for our data-driven marketing solutions, including the WPP Open platform. You'll be instrumental in translating user needs and data insights into clear product requirements, ensuring our solutions are innovative, valuable, and technically sound. Your strong understanding of data and SQL will be key to communicating effectively with engineering and data science teams and making informed product decisions. You are: Data-curious, with a proven ability to analyze information and derive actionable insights. Analytical and detail-oriented, capable of breaking down complex problems and defining clear product needs. An excellent communicator, able to bridge the gap between technical and business stakeholders. A proactive learner, eager to deepen your understanding of AdTech, product management, and data-driven methodologies. Collaborative, thriving in a cross-functional team environment and contributing to a shared vision.   WHAT YOU WILL DO Support Product Development & Lifecycle Management Assist in defining, documenting, and prioritizing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria based on user needs, business goals, and data analysis. Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Data Scientists, and UX Designers to ensure a shared understanding of product features and their underlying data implications. Help manage and refine product backlogs, participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews), and support release cycles. Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify opportunities and stay informed about industry trends in data and AI for marketing.   Leverage Data for Product Insights and Validation Utilize SQL and other data analysis tools to query datasets, analyze product performance, identify trends, and generate insights that inform product strategy and prioritization. Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to understand data availability, schemas, quality, and potential for new product features or enhancements. Define and track key product performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, helping to evaluate the success of new features post-launch. Help ensure data quality and integrity within product features, flagging discrepancies or potential issues.   Facilitate Stakeholder Communication & Feedback Communicate product updates, release notes, and progress to various internal stakeholders, effectively highlighting the data-driven rationale behind product decisions. Gather feedback from users, internal teams (e.g., commercial, operations), and clients to continuously iterate and improve our products. Support in preparing presentations and documentation to articulate product vision, strategy, and roadmap.   Continuous Learning & Contribution Actively seek to deepen your understanding of AdTech data, our internal platforms (including WPP Open), and user behaviors through self-study and mentorship. Contribute to the continuous improvement of product management processes and tools within the team.   WHAT YOU WILL NEED 0-2 years of experience in a product, business analyst, data analyst, or similar role with exposure to software development. Proficiency in SQL is essential, with the ability to write complex queries to extract, analyze, and manipulate data from various sources. Solid understanding of relational databases and data warehousing concepts. English fluency C2 Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a strong plus. Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and the software development lifecycle. Ability to define and document clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable product insights. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and vice-versa. Proven ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Marketing, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.   If you are ready to be at the forefront of the AdTech industry, shaping its future, and driving success for both our clients, we encourage you to apply and join our team. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.   We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. jobs.title: AI Product Owner
jobs.description: About Legal 500 Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients. Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms. We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol. About the Role: Our new AI Product Owner will provide central product ownership for AI capabilities developed and used across Legal 500, spanning multiple business units, functions and AI products. We see the primary premise of this role is to ensure that investment in AI is prioritised against Legal 500’s business objectives, that products solve clearly defined business problems, and that appropriate quality, governance, human oversight and accountability are built into their lifecycle. What you'll do: You will have the opportunity to operate as centrally within Legal 500, sitting within the 'Project' unit within our People & Business Operations function. You'll work across business-unit leaders, users, Technology, Data, Governance and relevant technology partners or suppliers. You'll be accountable for maintaining an enterprise AI product portfolio and roadmap and have responsibility for translating business needs into prioritised product requirements. This role is also about overseeing adoption and value realisation and ensuring AI products continue to improve as Legal 500’s operating models evolve. There is a possibility we may grow this team out to support on AI-specific engineering tasks. What we're looking for: Essential Strong product ownership background, ideally managing a portfolio of products or initiatives across multiple functions in an AI, data, digital or knowledge-intensive environment in a business change context Good understanding of how generative AI and related technologies can be applied to business processes (this role is not about having deep engineering expertise) Ability to quickly understand different business functions and complex processes, and translate them into clear product requirements, priorities and measurable outcomes Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge AI outputs and understand issues such as hallucination, bias, confidence and evidence quality Experience working across multiple business units and technology teams, balancing competing priorities and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Curious and comfortable challenging established ways of working with a commercial and outcome-focused approach rather than technology-led Comfortable working in an evolving environment where AI capabilities and operating practices will continue to change. Desirable An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets, research or other knowledge-intensive environments would be advantageous. Role information: Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote This role can be based in either London or Leeds Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds) Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d) - Internship - Digital Supply Chain
jobs.description: Notre équipe Digital Supply Chain recherche un·e Product Manager (f/m/d) en Stage, basé·e à Paris. Au sein du domaine "Downstream Replenishment", notre collectif a pour mission de concevoir et de transformer les produits numériques qui optimisent la disponibilité de nos produits sportifs dans le monde entier. Composée de Product Managers, Data Scientists et Data Analysts, notre équipe fait le pont entre la tech et le business pour relever un défi de taille : acheminer le bon produit, au bon endroit, au bon moment, grâce à l'IA et aux modèles de données avancés. TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION En tant que Stagiaire Product Manager, tu rejoins une équipe agile. Ta mission principale sera de prendre en charge le déploiement international de l'un de nos produits numériques clés auprès de nos entrepôts et magasins. Tes responsabilités principales : Soutien au Déploiement et à la Scalabilité du Produit : Participer activement au déploiement opérationnel de notre solution de supply chain à l'échelle internationale et aider à son industrialisation. Accompagnement au Changement : Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe pour accompagner les utilisateur·ices finaux·les (Supply Planners), faciliter l'adoption du produit et co-animer des sessions de formation. Appui au User Discovery : Contribuer à recueillir les retours qualitatifs et quantitatifs du terrain pour aider l'équipe produit à enrichir la roadmap et à optimiser les fonctionnalités futures. Suivi de la Performance : Aider à la mise en place et à l'analyse des indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs) liés à l'adoption du produit et à l'efficacité opérationnelle. Vie de l'Équipe Agile : Participer activement aux rituels de l'équipe (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, rétrospectives) pour s'imprégner de la culture agile. CE QUE TU APPORTES Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité curieuse, orientée solutions et dotée d'un excellent relationnel. Formation : En cours de Master (Bac+5) en école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou équivalent universitaire. Compétences relationnelles & Soft Skills : Capacité à vulgariser des concepts techniques pour des profils business, esprit d'analyse et autonomie. Appétences : Un fort intérêt pour les défis de la Supply Chain et la tech. Langues : Anglais courant indispensable (contexte international quotidien). Le français est un plus. Note importante : Si tu n'as pas d'expérience dans le sport mais que tu es passionné·e par les défis de la tech et de la supply chain, ta candidature a toute sa place chez nous !   STACK TECHNIQUE Outils de gestion de produit & Agile (Jira, Confluence) Outils d'analyse de données (Looker, SQL ou équivalents sont un plus) CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ; Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ; Développement des compétences et accompagnement (coaching sur mesure, formations internes et externes, etc.) ; Immersion dans notre culture sportive (accès aux clubs de sport internes, tests de produits). NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de tous niveaux de compétences à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es. Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement. DECATHLON DIGITAL  Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits. Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
